name.full: Chat to Lead - capture and follow up

description.short: Turn chat messages into structured leads and scheduled follow-ups.
description.full: Send lead details as text, a shared contact or a photo of a business card. Chat to Lead extracts the details, confirms what it captured, asks for anything missing rather than guessing, stores the lead, and schedules your follow-up.

commands.title: Add a lead
commands.description: Send company, name, mobile and email as text

commands.title: Business card
commands.description: Send a photo of a business card
